title: Harnessing mucosal and systemic immunity against respiratory viruses: vaccine platforms, delivery strategies, and adjuvants.
snippet: Long-lasting immunity against respiratory viruses, including influenza, COVID-19, and respiratory syncytial virus, remains a challenge. Effective vaccines and vaccination strategies that confer durable protection against these viruses require the induction of both systemic and mucosal immunity.
